attchmntText: Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about the Subscription to the Warrants issued by Bajaj Finance Limited, a listed subsidiary of the Company
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finserv Limited subscribed to 5,74,25,740 warrants issued by its listed subsidiary, Bajaj Finance Limited, on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is convertible into one equity share of Bajaj Finance Limited. The subscription was made at an issue price of Rs. 1,010 per warrant. The total aggregate consideration amounts to Rs. 57,99,99,97,400. This transaction was executed on a preferential allotment basis. The Board of Directors had previously approved this subscription on 1 October 2026. The maximum cash consideration approved was Rs. 5,800 Crore. The actual amount subscribed is slightly below the approved limit. This information is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finserv Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 3 November 2026. Consolidated profit after tax grew 25% to INR 5,952 crores. Bajaj General Insurance reported a combined ratio of 104.5%, impacted by INR 75 crores in NATCAT claims. Bajaj Life Insurance saw VNB grow 40% to INR 512 crores. Bajaj Finance booked new loans worth INR 1.34 crores and reported PAT of INR 6,367 crores. The Board approved an additional capital raise of INR 11,700 crores via QIP and INR 5,800 crores via preferential issue, subject to shareholder approval. Bajaj Housing Finance surpassed INR 1.5 lakh crores in AUM. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'information pertaining to the unlisted insurance subsidiaries of the Company'.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finserv Limited filed information under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding its unlisted insurance subsidiaries. For Bajaj General Insurance Limited, gross direct premium underwritten excluding crop and government health business was Rs. 1,991 crore for October 2026, compared to Rs. 1,595 crore in October 2025. Total gross direct premium underwritten was Rs. 2,142 crore for October 2026 versus Rs. 1,910 crore in October 2025. For Bajaj Life Insurance Limited, new business information for the month ended 31 October 2026 totaled Rs. 1,355.19 crore, compared to Rs. 1,135.39 crore in the same period of 2025. Cumulative figures up to October 2026 show Bajaj General Insurance at Rs. 14,940 crore total premium and Bajaj Life Insurance at Rs. 10,202.99 crore new business. The data is provisional and subject to limited review by statutory auditors.
